current_evidence: The council's 'Submitting a planning application' page 3 (published 10 March 2026) links to the 'Validation Checklist' download page. That page states 'Adopted: June 2025' (published 8 January 2026), and the PDF text itself is dated June 2025. It supersedes the 'adopted December 2012, amended May 2023' version that planning.data.gov.uk entity 20113 still lists.

issues.detail: Grokbot's link works; it is not blocked or 404 as the Status claims. But it is page 2 of the 'Submitting a planning application' guide, which covers publishing applications online and keeping personal or confidential data out of submissions. It is not the validation list. The list is linked from page 3 ('Basic information and links to detailed information') as a separate download.
issues.evidence: Page 2 content: neighbour comments not published after 23 May 2018; 'Confidential' marking guidance; no checklist

issues.detail: The current list is 'Validation checklist for planning and other applications', dated June 2025, with a Self or Custom Build proforma. The 'Planning page' field points to planning.data.gov.uk entity 20113 rather than a council page, and that dataset still holds the superseded 'adopted December 2012, amended May 2023' PDF. issues.detail: The List date is blank and 'Outdated (>2y)?' is null. The source is dated June 2025, so the list is current (under 2 years old).

issues.detail: No requirements were captured: tab_items is empty and every app type shows '(none)'. The June 2025 list has 47 local requirements (sections 15-61), each with triggers. Key ones: Street scene elevations (new buildings in prominent/sensitive locations or infill plots); Shopfront details (all new shopfronts); Listed building plans (LBC with elevational changes); Statement of Community Involvement (major development with significant public interest; wind turbines >2 or hub height >15m); Planning statement (all major; departures; adverts; turbines); Structural survey (barn/building conversions outside urban areas; land instability; demolition prior notification); Tree survey (development affecting trees on or adjacent to site); Ecological/bat and bird surveys (incl. householder roof works); Biodiversity net gain (major from 12 Feb 2024, non-major from 2 Apr 2024); Landscaping incl. LVIA (major and most full applications); Heads of terms (major residential for POS; major for highways/transport/affordable housing); Open space (major residential); Transport assessment (all major; near level crossings); Travel plan (major retail, employment, leisure, education); Parking/cycle/accessibility (new development, change of use, householder affecting parking); Retail sequential and impact (main town centre uses; Policy DM3 thresholds); Flood risk assessment (FZ2/3/3b; FZ1 at 1ha or more; householder in flood zone); Drainage strategy (major; FZ2/3); Archaeological assessment; Heritage statement (listed buildings, conservation areas, registered parks and gardens); Refuse/recycling (new dwellings, retail/business, industrial); Contaminated land (known or suspected contamination; sensitive end uses); Noise impact; Air quality (100+ parking spaces outside an AQMA, 50+ inside, 20+ retail inside, dwellings/schools in an AQMA); Odour (A3/A5 uses); Flues/extraction (cooked food, launderettes); Lighting (floodlighting near homes, illuminated adverts, arenas/pitches); Photographs/photomontages (demolition, turbines, buildings over 18m); Affordable housing statement; Crime impact statement (25+ dwellings); Coal mining risk assessment (EIA development; Development High Risk Area); Sunlight/daylight; Financial viability; Proof of marketing (employment sites, community facilities, pubs); Green belt assessment (replacement buildings/extensions in Green Belt); Agricultural statement; Telecommunications; Demolition of buildings; Self and custom build proforma; Battery energy storage compliance statement (BESS of 1 MWh or over). Also missing: site plan, floor plans, elevations, sections and site levels (items 15-19).
issues.evidence: Checklist sections 15-61 'Local requirements'; e.g. 45 Air quality: '50+ new parking spaces inside an AQMA'; 61: 'Battery Energy Storage Sites of 1 MWh or over'

issues.detail: Hyndburn-specific submission points on page 3 were not captured: maps must show the OS or other provider's licence number; all drawings must have a scale bar and show the paper size; the Agricultural Holdings section must be completed in all cases.
issues.evidence: Page 3: 'Maps must show the appropriate OS or other provider's Licence Number'; 'All drawings must have a scale bar and show the paper size'

summary: Grokbot's link opens a working guidance page about personal data in submissions, not the validation list, and it wrongly marked the list unreadable. The current list is Hyndburn's June 2025 'Validation checklist for planning and other applications', with 47 local requirements and clear triggers, none of which Grokbot captured.
